chapter.verse: Topa ’ hong huh ding ngenin ka kiko a, Topa tungah ka thuum hi.
Ama mai-ah ka lungkim lohna ka sung a, ama mai-ah ka haksatna ka gen hi.
Ka cih nading ka theih nawn loh ciangin, amah in ka mailam ding hong theihsak hi. Ka paina lampi-ah ka galte in tehlop khat tawh kei hong siahsim uh hi.
Ka kiim ka pam enin ka khuadak a, ahih hangin kei hong huh ding kuamah om lo hi; ka belh ding kuamah om lo a, kuamah in kei hong don lo hi.
Topa aw, nang tungah kong kiko hi; nang in keima belh na hi a, a hingte’ leitangah keima tanh na hi hi, kong ci hi.
Ka kikona hong ngai in; bang hang hiam cih leh kei hong kiniamkoih mahmah hi! Kei hong bawlsiate’ kiang panin hong honkhia in; bang hang hiam cih leh kei’ adingin amaute hatlua uh hi!
Thong sung panin kei hong lakhia in! Tua ciangin nangma mite tawh na min kong phat khawm ding uh hi; bang hang hiam cih leh nang in itna lianpi tawh kei tungah nong gamta hi.
